title: verbascum phlomoides proles nemorosum
intro: Verbascum phlomoides proles nemorosum, commonly known as Woodland Mullein, is a biennial plant species in the figwort family (Scrophulariaceae). It has been traditionally used for its medicinal properties, providing relief from various health issues. The plant is known for its anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antitussive properties, which contribute to its therapeutic actions in treating respiratory issues, such as coughs and bronchitis. The bioactive constituents of Verbascum phlomoides proles nemorosum include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and iridoids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties and are being studied for their potential health benefits, including antioxidant and anti-inflammatory effects.
